org.settings.fanClubShare.title: Fan club share
org.settings.fanClubShare.intro: Members whose contract includes their fan club can make it part of the organization; the organization then receives this share of the club's revenue. Changing it never affects existing arrangements — creators keep the rate from when they opted in.

org.settings.subscription.inactiveNotice: Not active — members keep their personal subscriptions.
org.settings.subscription.contactUs: This arrangement is managed by Literary Universe — contact us to change the tier, the member limit, or to activate it.
org.admin.subscription.hint: While active, every active member of the organization receives the selected tier and the member limit hard-caps active membership. Billing is handled offline — only activate for organizations that pay their bills. Changes apply to members within an hour.
org.licenses.title: Organization licenses
org.licenses.intro: Licenses your organization derives from the LU licenses. Members and talent can apply them to their works; the organization's share is taken from the author's part of the revenue split. Terms are fixed on creation — to change them, archive the license and create a new one. Archiving only removes a license from the pickers for new works; it stays in force on works already using it.
org.licenses.legal.label: Link to the full legal text
org.licenses.baseLicense.label: Based on LU license
org.workshop.licensed.intro: Works owned by their creators that carry one of your organization's licenses. You can promote them; editing stays with the owner.
